meta.label: Phase 1.10 Physics Reconciliation Layer (Calibration v5)
meta.description: Phase 1.10: Physics Reconciliation Layer bridges spin_pure_metrics (acceleration in isolation) with spin_game_metrics (position difference in play). Transfer functions measured across sweep ranges.

LONG_FACTOR.description: Pure longAccel_pxps = LONG_FACTOR × sy. Game drawBack ≈ -0.49 × LONG_FACTOR (converges at high values). Game followThrough ≈ -0.53 × LONG_FACTOR.

CURVE_FACTOR.description: Pure curveAccel_pxps = CURVE_FACTOR + SWERVE×(|sx|-0.3). Game yDeviation ≈ 0.21 × pureAccel. Transfer ratio stable at 0.21 across 5-40 range.

SWERVE_FACTOR.description: SWERVE contributes SWERVE×(|sx|-0.3) to pure lateral accel. At CURVE=20, SWERVE=1 adds 0.7px/s² (+3.5% to pure). Game impact is muted: SWERVE change from 0.1→5 only shifts game swerve by -0.6px (from -10.4 to -11.1).
SWERVE_FACTOR.game_muting: Game swerve is dominated by CURVE_FACTOR; SWERVE adds small delta

spread.label: Max object ball spread from table center

pockets.label: Number of pocketed balls on break

passRate.label: Fraction of shots that bounce off right rail at 85% power

finalX.label: Final x position of cue ball after 45-degree bank shot

longAccel_pxps.label: [PURE] Along-motion acceleration from LONG_FACTOR (zero friction/decay, no rails/collisions)
longAccel_pxps.note: Directly measures sy * LONG_FACTOR. Verified: 1 * 100 = 100 px/s².

curveAccel_pxps.label: [PURE] Lateral acceleration from CURVE_FACTOR + SWERVE (zero friction/decay, no rails/collisions)

swerveAccel_pxps.label: [PURE] Additional lateral acceleration from SWERVE_FACTOR alone

drawBack.label: [GAME] Cue ball position change on draw (noSpinX - drawX)
drawBack.note: Deterministic. Pure LONG_FACTOR_effect_pure = 100 px/s²; game drawBack = -49px (2nd collision amplified).

followThrough.label: [GAME] Cue ball position change on follow (followX - noSpinX)
followThrough.note: Deterministic. Pure LONG_FACTOR_effect_pure = 100 px/s²; game followThrough = -53px.

yDeviation.label: [GAME] Cue ball y-deviation from no-spin with side spin (sx=+1, power=70, rails active)
yDeviation.note: Deterministic. Pure CURVE_FACTOR_effect_pure = 20.7 px/s²; game yDeviation = 4.4px.

finalXDelta.label: [GAME] Cue ball x-position change after cushion bounce with side spin (30deg down-right shot)
finalXDelta.note: Deterministic. Pure CURVE + SWERVE = 21.4 px/s²; game swerve = -10.6px.

knownIssues.description: applyFrictionAndSpin used (nvx / nspd) instead of unit-vector-based direction, making spin effects geometric (speed-proportional).
knownIssues.resolution: Replaced with constant-acceleration model using unit vectors u and p.

knownIssues.description: LONG_FACTOR=0.028→100, CURVE_FACTOR=0.035→20, SWERVE_FACTOR=0.012→1 for constant-acceleration model.
knownIssues.resolution: Phase 1.8 sweep + Phase 1.9 pure isolation verification.

knownIssues.description: Draw/follow game scenarios (2-ball + cushion) amplify true spin effect into ~50px chaotic position difference via 2nd collision cascade. Sign inverted.
knownIssues.impact: spin_game_metrics.draw/follow unreliable for tuning. Use spin_pure_metrics (longAccel_pxps) as ground truth.
knownIssues.resolution: Phase 1.9 pure isolation + Phase 1.10 reconciliation layer: transfer function documented (gameDraw ≈ -0.49 × pureAccel).

knownIssues.description: SWERVE_FACTOR has minimal independent game impact. SWERVE change 0.1→5 only shifts game swerve by -0.6px. Game swerve dominated by CURVE_FACTOR.
knownIssues.impact: SWERVE_FACTOR optimization is low priority. Curve controls the swerve metric almost entirely.
knownIssues.target_fix: Consider merging swerve into curve, or raising SWERVE_FACTOR significantly if independent swerve effect is desired.
